text: [CG 04 35 03 05, ¶ A.2.b.] 2. [3:286] Claims-Made Coverage: EBL coverage is generally limited to a “claim” for damages first made against the insured during the policy period, based on an act, error or omission that took place during the policy period or within any earlier period covered by a retroactive date. (An extended reporting period is provided where the policy is canceled or not renewed.) [CG 04 35 03 05, ¶ A.1.b.] a. [3:286.1] When claim “made”: A claim is deemed made when “received and recorded” by the insured or the insurer, whichever comes first. (Claims received and recorded by the insured within 60 days after the policy period are covered if no subsequent policy is available.) Related claims are deemed made when the first claim is made against the insured. [CG 04 35 03 05, ¶ A.l.c., A.1.d.] 3.
